KV_Cr_CN6/A_pbeu_relax_scf_nscf_Ugrid: vc-relax of the 15-atom primitive cell (F-43m), then scf (5x5x5) and nscf (8x8x8) of the compensated state, and the FM reference, at the base U (3/3 eV) and on a U grid (2/2, 2/4, 4/2, 4/4 eV)
KV_Cr_CN6/B_pbeu_FM_fixed_moment: ferromagnet with the total moment fixed at 6 Bohr magnetons (exchange-energy reference) at each U point
KV_Cr_CN6/C_hse06_ideal_LCM: HSE06, compensated state of the ideal anhydrous crystal (q-mesh 2x2x2, k 4x4x4)
KV_Cr_CN6/D_hse06_ideal_FM_fixed_moment: HSE06, ferromagnet with the moment fixed at 6 (exchange-energy reference)
KV_Cr_CN6/E_hse06_ideal_LCM_nq1: HSE06, ideal crystal with q-mesh 1 (settings matched to the dihydrate run, for a like-for-like comparison)
KV_Cr_CN6/F_hse06_dihydrate_LCM: HSE06, KV[Cr(CN)6]*2H2O (21-atom cell, one ordered-water arrangement); job stopped after the exact-exchange error plateaued at ~1e-6 Ry; the last complete eigenvalue block is used
KV_Cr_CN6/G_pbeu_dihydrate: PBE+U relax, scf and nscf (6x6x6) of the same dihydrate model
KV_Cr_CN6/H_hse06_vacancy_with_water: HSE06, 65-atom cell with one [Cr(CN)6] vacancy filled by 6 coordinated + 1 zeolitic water (q-mesh 1, k 2x2x2)
KV_Cr_CN6/I_pbeu_vacancy_with_water: PBE+U relax, scf and nscf of the same water-filled vacancy cell
KV_Cr_CN6/J_pbeu_defect_supercell_pristi: 60-atom conventional cell without defects (reference for the defect cells)
KV_Cr_CN6/K_pbeu_defect_antisite_pair: one V/Cr antisite pair (the two metals swap places) in the 60-atom cell
KV_Cr_CN6/L_pbeu_defect_cyanide_flip: one cyanide flipped end-for-end (C and N exchanged)
KV_Cr_CN6/M_pbeu_defect_K_vacancy: one missing K+ ion (leaves a hole, V(II) -> V(III))
KV_Cr_CN6/O_pbeu_reference_K_H2O: reference energies of bcc K and a water molecule
KV_Cr_CN6/P_pbeu_bands_pdos: PBE+U band structure along high-symmetry lines and orbital-projected density of states
KV_Cr_CN6/Q_hse06_control_CrCr_same_elem: HSE06 control: Cr[Cr(CN)6], the same framework with the same metal on both sites
YBaMnFeO5/A_pbeu_vcrelax_110Ry: vc-relax of the 18-atom rock-salt-ordered P4/n cell (G-type) at 110 Ry
YBaMnFeO5/B_hse06_G_type_LCM: HSE06, G-type compensated ground state (36-atom 1x1x2 cell, q-mesh 2x2x1, k 5x5x2)
YBaMnFeO5/C_hse06_Yflip_competitor: HSE06, closest competing magnetic order (spins flipped across the Y layer)
YBaMnFeO5/D_pbeu_72atom_G_FM_and_spin_fl: 72-atom 2x2x1 cell: G-type, ferromagnet, and spin-flip snapshots (one Fe, one Mn, two far, two near spins reversed); scf + nscf
YBaMnFeO5/E_pbeu_antisite_reference: 72-atom reference cell for the Mn/Fe antisite study (75 Ry)
YBaMnFeO5/F_pbeu_antisite_pair_nearest: nearest-neighbour Mn/Fe swap (12.5 % of B sites), relaxed; scf + nscf
YBaMnFeO5/G_pbeu_antisite_pair_far: far-separated Mn/Fe swap, relaxed; scf + nscf
YBaMnFeO5/H_pbeu_stacking_vs_U: 36-atom cell, G vs Y-layer flip vs Ba-layer flip, at U(Mn,Fe) = (0,0) (2,2) (4,4) (6,6) (4,6) (6,4) eV, 90 Ry
YBaMnFeO5/I_pbeu_exchange_fit_configs: 24 collinear spin configurations (18- and 36/72-atom cells) used for the exchange fit, U = 4 eV, 90 Ry
YBaMnFeO5/J_cation_order_cluster_expansi: raw inputs/outputs of the cation-ordering study, all four rounds as the agents ran them (round 1 at the top level, then v2, v3, v4; earlier rounds include stopped or superseded runs). Only v4 feeds the cluster expansion: 21 Mn/Fe arrangements of YBaMnFeO5 (relaxation, then single points for several spin configurations; 96 energies in the fit) and the YBaCuFeO5 benchmark arrangements
YBaMnFeO5/K_hull_competing_phases_raw: raw inputs/outputs of the 0 K hull: vc-relax at 110 Ry of three YBaMnFeO5 cells and 33 competing phases (Materials Project / Alexandria structures, CC BY 4.0), with magnetic-configuration scans
